reason: Every TypeVar in sansio (app.py:44-50, scaffold.py:27-39, blueprints.py:18-31) is a decorator TypeVar with bound=ft.*Callable, but the group is all module-level exported values and the sole outlier, blueprints.py:17 DeferredSetupFunction, is a plain t.Callable type alias with no TypeVar call, so any new alias or constant would be flagged for nothing.
